📋 3. Specific Notes to Give to the Printing / Fabrication Shop

Recommended Size: 8 ft × 3 ft (96" × 36") or 10 ft × 3.5 ft (scalable vector included).
Substrate / Material: Option A: Star Blackout Flex (Heavy GSM, Matte finish to avoid sunlight glare).
Option B: Cast Vinyl with matte lamination pasted on 3mm ACP (Aluminium Composite Panel) sheet.
Border & Finishing: 1-inch hem on all 4 sides with rope reinforcement + Brass eyelets/grommets every 2 feet.
Color Space: CMYK — Deep Judicial Navy (#0A1C3D) and Metallic Brass Gold (#D4AF37).
